purpose: Make architecture, culture and whole-system review obligations executable instead of relying on memory.

lenses.purpose: Prove what the change is for, where its canonical identity lives and why it belongs there.
requiredQuestions: What human or institutional burden is this relieving?
Which source owns the meaning?
Is this universal, platform-specific, generated or historical?
Does an existing registry/process/component already own this responsibility?

lenses.purpose: Keep stable identity, parent/child relationships, aliases and traversal routes explicit.
requiredQuestions: Does every new screen, region, element, process, tool, state and projection have one stable ref?
Are parent and cross-domain edges registered once?
Can a bounded Atlas query find it without a grep hunt?

lenses.purpose: Make localization and intention-preserving communication foundational.
requiredQuestions: Does every visible string have a stable stringRef?
Is original speech preserved beside translations/refinements?
Are fallback and missing-translation states deterministic?
Could this layout break under longer or RTL text?

lenses.purpose: Prevent one-off interface code and visual drift.
requiredQuestions: Is this built from registered tokens/components/action vessels?
Should it be a menu item, FAB/action vessel, shared button, panel or platform-native equivalent?
Does the component expose stable identity, states and accessibility semantics?

lenses.purpose: Protect calm human use across companionship, leadership, hybrid and newcomer paths.
requiredQuestions: What does the user expect to happen?
Are scroll, zoom, pan, drag, back, focus and selection unambiguous?
Can a newcomer safely test mistakes and recover?
Can Vex Guide explain the current screen from semantic trajectory rather than raw click spam?

lenses.purpose: Keep keyboard, screen-reader, reduced-motion, magnification and small-screen use complete.
requiredQuestions: Is meaning independent of color and pointer precision?
Is every control named and reachable?
Is there a non-spatial alternative to Terrain?
Does reduced motion preserve comprehension?

lenses.purpose: Enforce one owner per state domain, narrow selectors and semantic distinct-until-changed delivery.
requiredQuestions: Who owns the canonical state?
Which consumers observe which selectors?
Will equal semantic output suppress rerender/snapshot churn?
How is current distinguished from history and unknown?

lenses.purpose: Prevent races, identity collapse and undirected communication.
requiredQuestions: Who is speaker, recipient, witness and transport?
Which writer owns the effect?
What happens if state changes while the model is thinking?
How are retries, deduplication, cancellation and return routing handled?

lenses.purpose: Make security and permission gates part of the interface contract.
requiredQuestions: What data/effect boundary is crossed?
What is the most restrictive authority intersection?
Can the model inspect this without being allowed to mutate it?
What private data is explicitly excluded from projections, logs and public export?

lenses.purpose: Preserve license, origin, contribution and public-claim integrity without turning developers into lawyers.
requiredQuestions: What is the source and license of every added dependency/asset/snippet?
Does this alter public claims, trademarks, user data or contribution terms?
Is legal uncertainty preserved and routed rather than guessed?
Does public export exclude private or third-party restricted material?

lenses.purpose: Keep local hardware, token, time, I/O and human-attention use bounded.
requiredQuestions: What resource envelope does this require?
Can deterministic retrieval replace a model call?
Is context source-descendable and within the serialized token budget?
Does background work yield to interactive conversation?

lenses.purpose: Offload repetition into mature functions, registries and generated projections.
requiredQuestions: Is this repetition generic, domain-specific, intentionally different or accidentally divergent?
Can a registry entry replace a switch?
Can one super-function or process definition serve all consumers?
What complexity can be removed rather than abstracted?

lenses.purpose: Make mistakes, upgrades and deletion recoverable and traceable.
requiredQuestions: What is the before-image, rollback and quarantine route?
Can migration be retried or resumed without overwriting accepted state?
Does deletion preserve a tombstone and recovery window?
Will a future instance understand why this changed?

lenses.purpose: Require evidence from each environment instead of assuming browser behavior generalizes.
requiredQuestions: Which behavior is universal and which belongs to the platform adapter?
Which OS, device, lifecycle, permission, line-ending, filesystem or packaging differences matter?
What does generated scaffold prove versus not prove?

lenses.purpose: Ensure important currentness, debt and consequences are perceivable without raw engineering noise.
requiredQuestions: Who needs to see this and at what depth?
Should it appear in Terrain, Health, Root Hub, Guide, a menu or only audit evidence?
What semantic transition merits a durable notice?
Can the projection remain compact and source-descendable?

lenses.purpose: Look for failure modes beyond the happy-path implementation.
requiredQuestions: Which malformed, stale, duplicated, interrupted or hostile inputs must fail closed?
What assumption is easiest for a future agent to miss?
What test proves the boundary, not just the output?
What does passing still not prove?
